content:
infra-bot: [ALERT] SEV2 - KV cache growth + continuous-batching amplification detected. model=mistral-1.2-mqa, region=us-west-2. p95 latency ↑ 2.8x, token egress ↑ ~6x for affected shards. Auto-scaling triggered. Pager: @oncall. Alert: https://internal/alerts/1807501234
Alex B: Ack — I'm on call. Jumping into dashboards now.
Mira S: pulling kv/cache dashboards (kv size, prefix hitrate, batching window distribution).
Sam P: seeing correlated spikes on qwen-mqa too; looks like shared KV namespace for multi-model routing.
Jamie L: runbook suggests immediate: 1) reduce batching window 2) evict hot prefixes 3) lower per-model max_batch_tokens. Applying now.
Ravi K: any customer-facing impact yet? error rates or rate-limiting?
Alex B: initial scan: small set of dedicated tenants showing elevated costs (token usage) and p99 tail latency >5s. Hosted customers appear mostly unaffected (different routing).
Jamie L: applying hotfix: reduce continuous_batch.window_ms from 50 -> 5 for canary in us-west-2. Command (canary):
```bash
curl -XPOST https://admin.api.redwood/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${ADMIN_TOKEN}' -d '{"continuous_batch.window_ms":5}'
```
Jamie L: rolled to canary -> staging okay -> rolling to 4 shards in us-west-2 now.
deploy-bot: deploy started for config change (canary -> region/us-west-2).
Alex B: watching metrics: within 3m p95 trending down from 2.8x to ~1.3x. Good signal.
Mira S: kv size on shard-17 still climbing >120GB, eviction backlog. Launching manual eviction job: `kv_eviction --shard 17 --target-rate 2000`
Sam P: also lowering per-model batch caps: Llama variants max_tokens 512 -> 256; Qwen/MQA max_tokens 256 -> 128 to reduce amplification on MQA prefix expansion.
Jamie L: enabled `kv.strict_ttl = true` for affected model group to accelerate natural decay (risk: slightly higher miss rate).
Ravi K: does strict_ttl affect inference quality?
Sam P: small risk for long conversation contexts with MQA; we flagged for QA. For short chat flows it's negligible.
Alex B: customer impact note -> CS: potential billing spikes and elevated latency between 14:02-14:48 UTC for dedicated tenants t-143 and t-712. Marking for priority outreach.
Mira S: can someone post the exact commands/config diffs into the incident doc? I'll include them in the handoff.
Jamie L: paste of diffs: 
```json
{"continuous_batch.window_ms":50} -> {"continuous_batch.window_ms":5}
{"model_profiles":{"qwen-mqa":{"max_batch_tokens":256}}} -> {"model_profiles":{"qwen-mqa":{"max_batch_tokens":128}}}
{"kv":{"strict_ttl":false}} -> {"kv":{"strict_ttl":true}}
```
Alex B: observed side effects: lower batching window increased request parallelism slightly but overall CPU stable; cost tradeoff better than runaway kv growth.
oncall-bot: handoff scheduled at 22:00 UTC to Mira S. Add runbook link and actions executed.
Mira S: taking handoff. TL;DR: root cause hypothesis = continuous-batching window interacting with MQA token-prefill behavior leading to exponential KV prefix growth on long-lived conversations. Hotfixes applied: reduced batch window, lowered per-model batch caps, manual eviction, enabled strict_ttl. Immediate metrics recovered to near-baseline within ~12 minutes of rolling.
ops-runbook-bot: runbook: https://runbooks/kv-batch-mqa (contains mitigation steps + playbook).
Alex B: Incident severity: SEV2. Start: 1807501234. Impact: partial degradation for some dedicated tenants (token cost and latency). Postmortem owner: Jamie L.
Jamie L: I'll open the postmortem doc and include timeline, diffs, dashboards, and suggested long-term fixes: 1) auto-evict when shard > threshold 2) per-tenant kv backpressure + router-level backpressure 3) model-specific batch profiles (prevent MQA-prefill amplification) 4) regression test simulating MQA prefix expansion.
Sam P: I'll add instrumentation: per-tenant token counter + alert if >3x baseline in a 15m window; also add shard kv-growth alert.
Mira S: notes for next oncall: commands run, manual eviction PID, list of affected shards, config rollback steps, and where to look for regression signals.
Alex B: customers to notify: t-143, t-712 (dedicated us-west-2). CS and billing ops looped in.
Ravi K: legal/compliance notified for potential billing disputes.
Jamie L: last significant mitigation executed at 1807503520 (manual eviction and final config roll). Handoff completed at 1807504321. Monitoring window 2h to confirm stability.
Mira S: leaving runbook link, metrics snapshot, and contacts in the incident doc. I'll follow up if we see KV re-growth.
Alex B: thanks all — will schedule postmortem within 48h and include action owners.
Jamie L: postmortem created: https://pm.reports/incident/1807501234 — assigning remediation tasks now.
infra-bot: Incident status -> mitigated. Continue monitoring. :thumbsup:
Alex B: closing for now from oncall. Keep channel for follow-ups.
_note: This JSON represents a single Slack thread as required by agents.md. The content string contains the root message and replies concatenated in chronological order, each prefixed by sender display name.
